# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-twenties  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v3 c1 P17](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0017), [v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P2](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Former teacher; currently a married homemaker  <sub>[v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is described as a neat, plain, wholesome girl with a stout, fat figure. She lacks the striking beauty of some of her peers, but dresses in a neat and sensible fashion.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P3](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0003), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

## Personality

Jane is a practical, sensible, and matter-of-fact girl who lacks a vivid imagination. She is conscientious, neat, and industrious, always striving to do her duty without fuss. While she is generally kind-hearted and agreeable, she can be a bit rigid, unemotional, and firm in her views regarding discipline and etiquette.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P3](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0003), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001), [v2 c4 P14](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0014), [v2 c4 P25](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0025), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

- Practical and matter-of-fact  <sub>[v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001)</sub>

## Abilities

- Domestic science and cooking  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- Crocheting and needlework  <sub>[v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v3 c1 P20](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0020)</sub>

## Goals

- To earn her salary, please school trustees, and achieve a good teacher's report  <sub>[v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001)</sub>
- To marry a reliable man and build a comfortable home  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## History

Jane Andrews grew up in Avonlea as one of Anne Shirley's primary classmates and friends. After studying at Queen's Academy, she earned a teacher's license with honors in domestic science. She taught school at Newbridge and later took a teaching position in western Canada. While in the West, she met and became engaged to Edward Inglis, a wealthy English Winnipeg millionaire. Returning to Avonlea, she was married in a grand ceremony at her home before moving to Winnipeg with her husband and later traveling to Europe on their honeymoon.

_Sources: [v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v3 c36 P32](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0032), [v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v3 c39 P35](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0035)_

- Daughter of Harmon and Mrs. Harmon Andrews of Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- Attended Avonlea School and Queen's Academy with Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>
- Member of the Avonlea Story Club and the Avonlea Village Improvement Society  <sub>[v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010)</sub>
